gloss: worker (in a field); person engaged in

definitions.gloss: worker (in a field); person engaged in
definitions.explanation: A person who works in a given field or occupation. Used after the name of the field, as in {医療|いりょう}{従事者|じゅうじしゃ} (health-care workers).

examples.japanese: ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧{従事者|じゅうじしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}する→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧{従事者|じゅうじしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The number of people working in agriculture falls every year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧{従事者|じゅうじしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: The shortage of care workers is a major problem for Japan's aging society.

notes:
From ⟦{従事|じゅうじ}→従事：12562_juuji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be engaged in) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). A formal word of statistics, official documents and the news; in conversation people name the job instead (⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧, ⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧{従事者|じゅうじしゃ}: health-care workers
- ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧{従事者|じゅうじしゃ}: agricultural workers
- ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧{従事者|じゅうじしゃ}: care workers
